It returns (None, None) on invalid JSON, on a TypeError, or when the JSON isn't a dict. That matches the request. Suggested 60-minute split: B 40 min (the parser, its callers in `receive`, and `decoded_correct`); D 12 min (honest.py `_assignment` at line 198 is a similar parser, but it returns only the assignment, a single value, so it is a near-miss); A 5 min (study.py `parse_assignment` at line 306 is also assignment-only); C 3 min (visibility.py has no matching parser). All four handoff_refs files contain the same generic text with no file-specific priority, so I chose B and D from the code. Choosing D is a judgment call. Nothing in the ref files supports it over A or C.
